name: UMaine 4-H Camps (Blueberry Cove, Bryant Pond, Greenland Point, Tanglewood)
phone: 207.665.2068 (Bryant Pond & Greenland Point, Bethany); 207.789.5868 (Tanglewood & Blueberry Cove, Emma)
description_short: Four UMaine 4-H camps in Maine offer summer programs of one to three weeks, in both day and overnight formats. Programs include outdoor skills, shooting sports, STEM, creative arts, ecology, gardening and teen leadership.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: It’s Time to Think About Summer Camp! - Cooperative Extension: 4-H - University of Maine Cooperative Extension

warnings: Source is a UMaine Extension 4-H news/blog post (March 2, 2026), not a camp registration page. It covers four separate camps in one post.
Only the 2026 season is shown, and it is already over (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 information is given.

The listed dates are each camp's overall season window, not bookable sessions, so no sessions were recorded. 2026 windows: Blueberry Cove (Tenants Harbor) June 21-Aug 14; Bryant Pond (Bryant Pond) June 21-Aug 14; Greenland Point (Princeton) June 28-July 31; Tanglewood (Lincolnville) June 21-Aug 21.
camp_type left blank because the post says both day and overnight programs are offered.
